title: Card failure lines splice Home Assistant's English exception text into sv/de messages
claim: In the pin_fail and save_fail error states, every sv and de cell (24 of 24: 2 states x 3 viewports x 2 themes x 2 languages) renders a mixed-language failure line such as 'Kunde inte spara: A hot water minimum of 52 °C leaves no deadband ...', because the card prints err.message (the English text Home Assistant formats for a translation_key exception) instead of the integration's own translated exception message.
mechanism: The card's ten failure sites build their line as L('errors.could_not_*', {err: (err && err.message) || err}). For an integration exception raised with translation_domain/translation_key, Home Assistant's websocket error carries `message` formatted from the en translations and the translation fields beside it; the card never reads translation_key and never calls hass.localize, so the localized prefix ('Kunde inte spara:', 'Speichern nicht möglich:') is followed by an English sentence, although translations/sv.json and de.json carry that very exception's message.

evidence.unit: count of sv/de cells whose failure line contains an en exceptions.*.message prefix
evidence.machine: box B10 (4 vCPU, Linux, Chromium 1243 via playwright 1.63.0, Node 22)
evidence.contention_note: ran beside the seat's own full-grid run; a count, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js:ManualPlan.slotResult (pin) / WhatIfPanel.onSaveSchedule (save) (the `(err && err.message) || err` failure lines, driven through hass.callService rejections)

perturbation.change: --perturb=err_localize: every `(err && err.message) || err` site first reads hass.localize(`component.${err.translation_domain}.exceptions.${err.translation_key}.message`, err.translation_placeholders)

metric_definition: sv/de cells of pin_fail/save_fail whose .wi-pin-result/.wi-result text contains the leading literal of any translations/en.json exceptions.*.message
phenomenon_property: A failure line the card shows in a non-English UI is entirely in that UI's language whenever the integration ships a translation for the error it reports.

null_control.note: a rejection with no translated counterpart (the P9 grid's plain 'Service call failed') leaves 0 lines matching an en exception message: the count is keyed on Home Assistant's translated-exception shape, and en cells are excluded by construction

reproduction_steps: Set the Home Assistant profile language to Svenska
Open the card's dialog, drag a hot-water slot, press the pin button while the integration refuses (e.g. no loaded entry) or save a schedule whose hot-water minimum leaves no deadband
Read the result line: Swedish prefix, English reason
proposed_fix_scope: One helper in the card that turns a service rejection into text: translated exception via hass.localize (after hass.loadBackendTranslation('exceptions', 'heatpump_optimizer')) when translation_key is present, else err.message; used by all ten failure sites.
criteria_statement: D4-criteria 'look professional' (D4.M3 error states; D4-criteria F3 'errors say what to change' in every language)
